title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct lifetime of the excited atom as 10^-8 s.

title: Understanding of Lifetime
description: Important Criteria: The student demonstrates understanding of the concept of atomic lifetime in the context of excited states.

title: Comparison of Values
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly compares the given lifetimes and identifies the most reasonable value.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes appropriate units in their final answer.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student mistakenly selects a lifetime that is not physically reasonable, such as 10^-1 or 10^-23 s.
